书童 Pagekin（原名 AI 小说作家）：开源免费的 AI 长篇小说写作桌面软件，从设定、蓝图到正文、审稿、定稿；支持拆解仿写、续写、改写，可导入写作 Skill（如去 AI 味）。模型需自行配置，作品在本地。Pagekin (formerly AI Novel Writer): free, open-source AI novel writing app for long novels and web fiction. Imitate, continue, rewrite; import writing skills. Local-first, no model bundled. Windows & macOS.
The next-generation Markdown editor, with an AI writing assistant. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.

The definitive MCP server for Scrivener — connect your novels, screenplays, and manuscripts to Claude, ChatGPT, and any AI assistant. 53 tools: document management, writing analysis, content enhancement, offline semantic search, and character/plot tracking.
A free, privacy-first tool that flags the tells of AI-generated writing, overused vocabulary, rhetorical crutches, robotic sentence rhythm and, for every finding, tells you how to fix it.

给中文网文作者的本地写作工作台（21 个工具）：动笔前取齐上一章承接口/大纲/人物卡/待回收伏笔/用语规范；写完后按六维文笔基线对照原著波动带自检，排出带原句行号的改稿待办；跨章查伏笔埋设跨度、人物连续缺席与大纲偏离；出错时可生成只含元数据、可安全分享的诊断报告。24MB 中文模型随包本地推理，零 token、正文不出本机。Local novel-writing workbench for DSH: 20 tools, on-device model, zero API cost.
Find the AI tells in your prose. Deterministic, local, runs in CI. MCP server + CLI + Action.
